content.text:
I don't think I'll do anything on my own yet. I'll ask you first.

I'm fairly sure of one thing: the page puts **"פסגות" with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)"** at the top and marks it "★ הזול". In their example you put in 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month for 10 years. That's "70,000 ₪" from your own pocket, and they say you'd be left with **"86,492 ₪"**. That big number is the one that stayed with me. The big banks come out lower on their list. "לאומי" is 83,396 ₪ and "הפועלים" is 81,471 ₪, and next to each it says "לא בחישוב". So it seems the banks take more. But Psagot isn't my bank, and I don't know them the way I know the bank.

What I looked at, in order:
- **Screen 1.** The heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד" and a row of buttons with English letters. One was "S&P 500" and was already chosen, so I stayed. Then the boxes "סכום היום" 10,000, "הפקדה חודשית" 500 and "שנים" 10, and the 70,000 next to the 86,492.
- **A black box "מס רק במכירה".** It covered the left side of every screen, all the way down. I couldn't read what was under it.
- **Screen 2.** A list of "חשבונות" on the right, Psagot first, then Leumi. A list of funds on the left full of coloured labels I don't know.
- **Screens 3 and 4.** More and more funds, many with red minus numbers like "‎-447 ₪", "‎-3,671 ₪" and "‎-4,492 ₪". The bar of colours meant nothing to me. Then whole lines in English, "iShares", "Vanguard", "UCITS ETF". That is where I stopped. The screens were dark, crowded and full of numbers, and they made me anxious.

What I didn't understand:
- Words in English letters: "S&P 500", "4D", "ETF", "UCITS", "Accumulating", "Dist", "TXF-11".
- Hebrew words I don't know: "קרן מחקה", "קרן סל", "צוברת", "מחלקת דיבידנד", "חשיפה לדולר", "עסקת החלף", "דמי משמרת", "נאמן 0.02%", "מנוטרל מט"ח", "מס רק במכירה".
- I wasn't sure what the minus numbers in red mean. Is it money you lose, or only less than the cheapest one?
- What was under the black box, I couldn't see.
- Small grey writing under the boxes, which I couldn't read. It said something about the dollar and "אינפלציה".

So I didn't see whether this is as safe as a deposit. Nothing on these screens said so. That's why I'll ask you, or the clerk at the bank.

But I don't know Psagot and saw nothing about safety, so I'll ask my son or the bank.
